name: marketplace-monorepo
description: Root tooling for the marketplace monorepo (backend + frontend) — git hooks and shared lint/format config only. Each app still has its own package.json and is installed/run independently.

scripts.lint:all: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.format:all: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.typecheck:all: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
